entries.title: A finished program no longer stops other tasks filed under it
entries.body: When a program finished, it also stopped every other task your first mate had filed under it, even work that was still going. Now it closes only its own parts. A part that says its checks are still running also stays open until it has its answer, so a loop no longer ends early on an unfinished round.
entries.noPicture: This changes which tasks close when a program ends, not a view or control.
